en: Vintage postcard showing the façade of an Italian café named "Caffè Bertolasi" on a town square. The building has multiple shuttered windows, a tiled roof, hanging street lamps, and a large awning sheltering tables and people gathered outside. Signs on the building read "CAFFÈ BERTOLASI" and "VINO E BIRRA". The right side of the card contains printed text describing the café and handwritten cursive correspondence.
